primer: Lenskart Solutions Ltd. is a vertically integrated eyewear compounder (₹10,383 Cr TTM revenue, 21% statutory OPM, 3,300+ global stores) that earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS on business quality. However, we reject new capital at the ₹732.10 session close (162.7x TTM P/E, 12.4x Sales, 6.55% ROE). Our probability-weighted 12–18M fair value is ₹615 (-16.0%). Retain 100% of marginal capital in Cash (0% TITAN, 0% METROBRAND).
